episodes.title: La chica del cumpleaños
episodes.summary: New student Javier starts school and meets the ever-observant Sofía. Another student's secret is publicly revealed, stirring up the school.

episodes.title: Víctimas
episodes.summary: The anonymous hacker continues to expose more students' secrets, with far-reaching consequences. As friendships are tested, Sofía investigates.

episodes.title: Idiotas
episodes.summary: Gerry's aggression toward Luis escalates. The hacker brings the situation to a boiling point. Sofía worries about the threats against her.

episodes.title: Clase nocturna
episodes.summary: Sofía's stress about the hacker threatens to overwhelm her. Raúl throws a big, raucous party for all the students. Natalia desperately needs money.

episodes.title: Cara a cara
episodes.summary: Raúl and Javier struggle to get along as they help Sofía track down the kidnapper. Meanwhile, the hacker threatens to reveal everyone's secrets.

episodes.title: ¿Qué tanto conoces a Javier?
episodes.summary: Javier's history is called into question when Raúl and Sofía look into a specific incident in his past. Gerry continues visiting Luis in the hospital.

episodes.title: Control Z
episodes.summary: A look back at the previous semester reveals the series of events that triggered the school-wide hack.

episodes.title: Enemigo público
episodes.summary: Quintanilla punishes a suspected student for the hacking. Rosita insists on throwing the school their anticipated NONA party, with many surprises.

episodes.title: No se puede enterrar el pasado
episodes.summary: An anonymous person seeks vengeance on behalf of Luis. Sofía must solve the first mystery in order to save two classmates before it's too late.

episodes.title: El Regreso
episodes.summary: When a certain someone returns to school, chaos breaks out. Natalia rushes to solve her financial dilemma. The search for the avenger heats up.

episodes.title: Necesidades
episodes.summary: Sofia and Javi try to predict what the avenger will do when Rosita insists on hosting a party at her house. Gerry feels cooped up at Raul's place.

episodes.title: Nada que esconder
episodes.summary: Natalia's account of what transpired the night before sparks an argument between Javi and Sofia. Pablo struggles with the news about María.

episodes.title: Nuevos placeres
episodes.summary: Raul and Sofia try to find Gerry before the avenger gets to him. Desperate to raise money, Natalia tries an unorthodox dating app.

episodes.title: Un minuto de silencio
episodes.summary: On the day of Quintanilla's goodbye ceremony, Sofia and Raul race to discern who the next victim will be. María attempts to help Natalia.

episodes.title: Control Z
episodes.summary: Sofía studies Luis' drawings to work out who the avenger is targeting next. Natalia and María accept an invitation. Rosita doesn't heed a warning.

episodes.title: La última venganza
episodes.summary: Multiple people's lives are put in danger when the avenger makes a final desperate move, leading to devastating consequences.

episodes.title: ¿Creías que me iba a olvidar de ti?
episodes.summary: A hacker has returned to torment the students with their secrets — and homes in on a night Sofía, Javi and friends would much rather put behind them.

episodes.title: ¿María?
episodes.summary: Pablo insists to Javi and Sofía that María is contacting him. Raúl prepares to sell his house. Gerry feels triggered when he witnesses bullying.

episodes.title: Has llegado a tu destino
episodes.summary: The investigation leads Sofía and Javi to Clau's theater teacher. Pablo grieves over the latest news. Raúl realizes he's been deceived.

episodes.title: Heridas abiertas
episodes.summary: More victims of the hacker's violence pile up, and a case of mistaken identity leads to a confrontation between Sofía and Natalia.

episodes.title: Helena
episodes.summary: Sofía is crushed by her most recent discovery, but continues her sleuthing. Alex warns Clau about Sebastián. Gerry and Bernardo become closer.

episodes.title: Game Master
episodes.summary: Javi gathers everyone together to make a new plan, but when an exasperated Sofía goes off-script, the stakes of the game are raised.

episodes.title: Yo soy @todostussecretos
episodes.summary: Sofía is deemed irrational when she insist that Raúl is innocent and in danger, so she decides to search for him solo. Gerry seeks a new home.

episodes.title: Graduación
episodes.summary: Gerry reaches out to the group when he suspects something is amiss and everyone must decide what to do to save their friends... and their futures.
